title_ar: الشيخ الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء يُحاضر في موضوع "الاختلاف.. سنة كونية" بدولة قطر
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew, President of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, Lectures in Qatar on "Disagreement — a Pattern Established in Creation"
body_ar:
استضاف معهد الدعوة والعلوم الإسلامية بالدوحة مساء أمس الاثنين 05 دجنبر 2012 فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء لإلقاء دورة علمية في مسجد عمر بن الخطاب بالدوحة بعنوان: "فقه الاختلاف .. سنة كونية".

هذا وصرح الدكتور محمد بن صلاح إبراهيم رئيس معهد الدعوة والعلوم الإسلامية في الافتتاح بأن "هذه الدورة مهمة حيث إنها تتطرق لموضوع مهم نحتاجه جميعا ألا وهو الاختلاف وما يترتب عليه .. خاصة أنه يعرفنا على اختلاف العلماء وكيف كان؟ وطريقتهم في التعامل مع المخالف.

وتتطرق هذه الدورة لعدة محاور تدور حول:

1- الاختلاف وأنواعه.

2- أنواع المخالفين والتعامل معهم.

هذا وقدم الشيخ قبل الدورة ثلاث محاضرات إحداهما عن السحر؛ الوقاية والعلاج، والثانية عن العين حق وما ورد في ذلك من الأحاديث، والثالثة عن : "كيف تعالج نفسك بالرقية الشرعية.

وسينشر الموقع بإذن الله لاحقا محاضرات تلك الدورة مع تلخيصها لتقريبها من الطلاب والمهتمين.

ولمتابعة الحلقة الأولى الرجاء الضغط هنا:
body_en:
The Institute of Daʿwah and Islamic Sciences in Doha hosted His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, on the evening of yesterday, Monday 05 December 2012, to give a course of instruction at the Mosque of ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab in Doha, entitled "The jurisprudence of disagreement — a pattern established in creation (sunnah kawniyyah)".

Dr Muhammad ibn Salah Ibrahim, president of the Institute of Daʿwah and Islamic Sciences, stated at the opening that "this course is important, in that it takes up an important subject that we all have need of — namely disagreement and what follows from it — especially as it acquaints us with the disagreement of the scholars and how it was, and with their way of dealing with one who differs from them.

This course takes up several strands, turning on:

1. Disagreement and its kinds.

2. The kinds of those who differ, and dealing with them.

Before the course the Sheikh gave three lectures: one of them on sorcery — prevention and treatment; the second on "the evil eye is real" and what has come down on that in the prophetic reports; and the third on: "How to treat yourself by means of the ruqyah sanctioned by the Sharia.

The site will publish the lectures of that course later, God willing, together with a summary of them, to bring them within reach of students and of those interested.

flags.context: the date of the course's opening
options: reproduce the year exactly as given and flag it
flags.note: The year in the body cannot be right. The record is timestamped Tuesday 6 December 2011 and says the course opened 'yesterday, Monday'; 5 December 2011 was indeed a Monday, whereas 5 December 2012 was a Wednesday. The body's 2012 is a typing error for 2011. Reproduced exactly as the source gives it and not corrected, per style guide section 11. Note the knock-on risk: a date-sorting pass over the corpus that trusts body text rather than the CMS field would file this record a year late.

options: a pattern established in creation (sunnah kawniyyah)
flags.note: سنة here is not the sunnah of the Prophet and must not be allowed to read as it: a sunnah kawniyyah is a regularity God has established in the created order, of the kind the Qur'an calls sunnat Allāh. The English needs to make that unmistakable, since 'sunnah' standing alone in an English title would be read the other way. The term is not in the glossary and recurs in the corpus.

flags.context: the course title in the body, against the title of the record
options: render both forms as each stands
flags.note: The record's own headline gives the title as "الاختلاف.. سنة كونية" while the body gives it as "فقه الاختلاف .. سنة كونية". Both are rendered as they stand, in title_en and in body_en respectively. The two are not the same title — the jurisprudence of disagreement is a named discipline, disagreement as such is not — and which the Sheikh used cannot be determined here.

flags.arabic: ثلاث محاضرات إحداهما عن السحر؛ الوقاية والعلاج … والثالثة عن : "كيف تعالج نفسك بالرقية الشرعية.
flags.context: the three lectures given before the course

flags.note: These are lecture titles only; the record gives no content from any of the three and states no ruling and no instruction. Raised here without setting editorial_review, because there is nothing in this record to review: it neither advises a course of treatment nor makes a claim about one. The flag is entered so that whoever handles the lectures themselves, if they enter the corpus, knows that material presented as self-treatment may need a different editorial judgement from a news announcement of it. Note also that إحداهما is the dual ('one of the two') where three are listed — a slip in the source, not corrected.

flags.arabic: بأن "هذه الدورة مهمة … وطريقتهم في التعامل مع المخالف.

translator_notes: A news report on the opening of a teaching course. It gives the course's two strands as headings and no content under either, so no ruling appears in the record.

The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. The body's own date is wrong by a year — see the flag — so neither field is reliable on its own; the day and month in the body, read against the timestamp, are the best evidence.

المخالف is rendered 'one who differs' rather than 'the opponent' or 'the dissenter'. In this literature it means a scholar who holds a different view within the bounds of legitimate disagreement, and the adversarial English words would prejudge the second strand's subject.
الرقية الشرعية is rendered 'the ruqyah sanctioned by the Sharia' — recitation over a person for healing, of the kind the Sharia permits, as against the kinds it does not. It is not in the glossary.
العين حق is a prophetic report ('the evil eye is real') used here as a lecture title; no collection and no grading is given in the source and none is supplied.
The closing 'to follow the first session please click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en.
